layout_sources: From memory of LHV internet bank "Account statement" CSV exports (English interface) as quoted in Estonian accounting-software import guides; not re-checked in this run (the web search budget was used up and no importer config for LHV was among the sources fetched).
notes: LHV account statement CSV, English column names (the Estonian interface gives the same 19 columns in Estonian: Kliendi konto, Dokumendi number, Kuupäev, ...). Comma-separated, every field double-quoted, UTF-8, ISO dates, Amount signed with a point decimal and the D/C column beside it, Fee, Currency EUR; an "Empty" column. No balance. Oldest first. File name, BOM and line ends not confirmed.
